query: For a 93‑year‑old male ICU patient on RRT: among male ICU patients aged 88–98, what percentile is an instability score of 85 in the first 72 hours, and what are ICU LOS and hospital mortality for the most unstable quartile?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.85) within GROUP (ORDER BY length_of_stay) AS instability_score_percentile, male_icu_patients.hadm_id, male_icu_patients.stay_id, male_icu_patients.intime, male_icu_patients.outtime, male_icu_patients.los, male_icu_patients.icd_code, male_icu_patients.icd_version FROM male_icu_patients JOIN instability_scores ON male_icu_patients.hadm_id = instability_scores.hadm_id WHERE male_icu_patients.anchor_age = 93 ORDER BY length_of_stay DESC LIMIT 1;
